tiny_geometry.calibration: pre-registered median-parity rule on the fixed 16 train-side images (pass-1 windows 0..1, seed0, parent state, eval-mode CPU-FP32 forward) via tools/geometry_probe.py; constant_C and constants_sha256 are filled once and never tuned

endpoint.note: unchanged fixed endpoint and scoring policy; no selection, no tuning

acceptance.note: engine acceptance only; its state is not usable for the formal training

gates.units: differences in percentage points (100 x (lhs - rhs))

A2_minus_A0.meaning: overall net benefit of the tiny-band geometry arm against the native arm

A2_minus_A1.meaning: increment from using the true matched tiny targets instead of the cyclically shifted ones

combination.note: no multi-seed, no follow-on round, and no metric-level selection is started automatically

frozen_science.mechanism: matched-pair geo slot replaced inside the tiny band only: 1-giou -> 1-exp(-sqrt(W2)/C); loss_bbox/L1, VFL, matcher, DN families, weights and normalization unchanged; zero parameters and zero new loss keys
frozen_science.control: A1 uses the identical formula, pair set and aggregation with the tiny target cyclically shifted within the criterion call by one draw from the term's own CPU generator; n<2 tiny pairs consumes no draw
frozen_science.band: raw canvas area <= 1024 px^2 on the 768x1344 canvas (normalized area <= 1024/1032192)
frozen_science.constant_C: filled by the pre-registered median-parity calibration once, then frozen
frozen_science.training_budget: 3,648 updates per arm, three arms, fixed endpoint FT012 EMA-C, no selection and no tuning
